name: version-bump end card
looks: A small mark sits alone over a plain field, with the product name beside it. A beat later the name updates in place to its next version number and a short 'out now' line fades in underneath, holding as the final frame.
build: Static DOM mark and wordmark; the version digit swaps with a quick scale/opacity snap (kit.typeOn-style single-character swap) rather than a full retype; the supporting line fades/rises 4-6px in on power2.out and holds at least 1s.
sound: A soft confirm tone on the version swap, with the bed fading out under the hold.
prompt: Close on a small mark and wordmark alone on a plain field; have the name's version number update in place with a quick snap, then fade in one short supporting line underneath and hold the finished card for at least a second.
